meta.name: product-manager-toolkit
meta.description: Comprehensive toolkit for product managers including RICE prioritization, customer interview analysis, PRD templates, discovery frameworks, and go-to-market strategies. Use for feature prioritization, user research synthesis, requirement documentation, and product strategy development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用框架和模板系统化推进产品管理工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是产品经理，需要结构化工具来管理需求、分析和策略。
copy.tagline_en: Systematize product management with frameworks and templates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product manager needing structured tools for requirements, analysis, and strategy.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可处理产品管理任务:用 RICE 方法排序功能(产出评分和路线图)、分析访谈文本(提取痛点和需求)、按模板撰写 PRD 文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求做功能优先级排序、用户调研总结、需求文档编写等产品管理任务时触发。

say.text: 用 RICE 给这些功能排序:①登录②看板③API。
say.note: 会运行 RICE 脚本输出排序。

say.text: 分析这段访谈记录,提取痛点、需求和关键引用。
say.note: 会调用访谈分析脚本,输出洞察。

say.text: 按单页 PRD 模板写需求文档:新增好友分组。
say.note: 会按模板生成 PRD 草稿。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude handles PM tasks: RICE feature prioritization (scores and roadmap), interview analysis (pain points and needs), and PRD drafting from templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests feature prioritization, user research synthesis, requirement documentation, or other PM tasks.

say_en.text: Use RICE to prioritize: login, dashboard, API.
say_en.note: Runs the RICE script and outputs ranking.

say_en.text: Analyze this interview transcript, extract pain points and needs.
say_en.note: Calls the interview analyzer for insights.

say_en.text: Write a one-page PRD for adding friend groups.
say_en.note: Uses the template to generate a PRD draft.
